title_zh: 亞什特 第 16 首‧奇斯塔讚（宗教女神讚）

segments.orig:
(pa nãm i ýazdã, hôrmezd i hvadâe
i awazûnî gurz hvarahe awazâyât,
dîn i vahe i mazdayasnã bê rasât,
 ezh hamâ gunâh ... pa patit hôm!) 
xshnaothra ahurahe mazdå, tarôidîti angrahe
mainyêush, haithyâvarshtãm hyat vasnâ
ferashôtemem. staomî ashem,
ashem vohû...(3).
fravarâne mazdayasnô zarathushtrish vîdaêvô
ahura-tkaêshô,
 (Here recite the appropriate Gah dedication.) 
razishtayå cistayå mazdadhâtayå ashaonyå
xshnaothra ýasnâica vahmâica xshnaothrâica
frasastayaêca,
ýathâ ahû vairyô zaotâ frâ-mê
mrûtê,
athâ ratush ashâtcît haca frâ ashava vîdhvå
mraotû!
segments.en:
May Ahura Mazda be rejoiced!....
Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathushtra,
one who hates the Daevas and obeys the laws of Ahura;
For sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification unto [Havani],
the holy and master of holiness....
To the most right Chista, made by Mazda and holy, and to the good
Law of the worshippers of Mazda.
Be propitiation from me, for sacrifice, prayer, propitiation,
and glorification.
Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness.....
segments.zh:
願阿胡拉‧馬茲達喜樂！....
阿舍姆‧沃胡：聖潔是一切善事中最好的....
我自認是馬茲達的崇拜者，查拉圖斯特拉的追隨者，
憎惡達埃瓦並服從阿胡拉律法的人；
為了獻禮、祈禱、安撫、以及讚美[Havani]，
聖潔且為聖潔之主....
至正的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，以及至善
馬茲達崇拜者之律法。
願成為我的贖罪，為祭祀、禱告、贖罪，
以及讚美。
Yatha ahu vairyo: 主的意志是聖潔之律法.....

segments.orig:
razishtãm cistãm mazdadhâtãm ashaonîm
ýazamaide hupathmainyãm huaiwitacinãm nimarezishtãm
barat-zaothrãm ashaonîm hunaravaitîm frasrûtãm
âsu-kairyãm moshu-kairyãm hvâyaonãm
hvâyaozdãm ýãm vanguhîm daênãm
mâzdayasnîm.
segments.en:
We sacrifice to the most right Chista, made by Mazda and holy:
we sacrifice to the good Law of the worshippers of Mazda, the
supplier of good stores, who runs quickly to the goal and frees
one best from dangers, who brings libations, who is holy, clever,
and renowned, speedy to work and quick of work; who goes quickly
and cleanses well; the good Law of the worshippers of Mazda;
segments.zh: 我們獻祭給最正確的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔：我們獻祭給馬茲達崇拜者的善法，善良倉庫的供應者，誰快速奔向目標並使最好的人免於危險，誰帶來祭酒，誰是聖潔、聰明且著名的，工作迅速且工作快速；誰迅速前行且清潔得好；馬茲達崇拜者的善法；

segments.orig:
ýãm ýazata zarathushtrô, use-hishta
haca gâtvô frashûsa haca demânât
razishte ciste mazdadhâte ashaoni, ýezi ahi paurva-naêmât
âat mãm avi nmânaya ýezi paskât
âat mãm avi apaya.
segments.en:
To whom Zarathushtra did sacrifice, saying: 'Rise up from
thy seat, come forward from the Abode, thou most right Chista,
made by Mazda and holy. If thou art before me, stay for me; if
thou art behind me, overtake me.
segments.zh: 誰 查拉圖斯特拉 曾獻祭，說：'起來離開你的座位，從居所前來，你最正確的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔。如果你在我前面，為我停留；如果你在我後面，超過我。'

segments.orig:
athanâ âxshta buyãn ýathanâ
buyât hvâyaonånghô pañtânô
hvâpathana garayô hvâtacina razura huperethwe
âfsh nâuya ahmâi saokâi frasastâi
fravâkâi uta framânâi.
segments.en:
'Let everything be as friendly to us as anything can be: may
we go smoothly along the roads, find good pathways in the mountains,
run easily through the forests, and cross happily the rivers!'
segments.zh: '讓一切對我們盡可能友好：願我們在道路上順行，在山中尋得良好路徑，在森林中輕鬆奔跑，並在河流中愉快地渡過！'

segments.orig:
ahe raya hvarenanghaca
tãm ýazâi surunvata ýasna
tãm ýazâi huyashta ýasna razishtãm
cistãm mazdadhâtãm ashaonîm zaothrâbyô,
razishtãm cistãm mazdadhâtãm ashaonîm
ýazamaide
haomayô gava baresmana hizvô danghangha mãthraca
vacaca shyaothnaca zaothrâbyasca arshuxdhaêibyasca
vâkhzhibyô.
ýenghê hâtãm âat ýesnê
paitî vanghô mazdå ahurô vaêthâ
ashât hacâ ýånghãmcâ tãscâ
tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
For her brightness and glory, I will offer unto her a sacrifice
worth being heard, namely, unto the most right Chista, made by
Mazda and holy. I will offer up a sacrifice unto the most right
Chista, made by Mazda and holy, with the libations, with the Haoma
and meat, with the baresma, with the wisdom of the tongue, with
the holy spells, with the words and deeds, with the libations,
with the well spoken words.
Yenhe hatam: All those beings of whom Ahura Mazda....
segments.zh:
為她的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽見的祭祀給她，也就是獻給最正確的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔。我將獻上祭祀給最正確的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，伴隨祭酒，伴隨豪麻與肉，伴隨巴雷斯瑪，伴隨舌之智慧，伴隨聖咒，伴隨言行，伴隨祭酒，伴隨言辭優美的話語。
彥赫哈塔姆：所有那些被阿胡拉‧馬茲達....

segments.en:

並為這福祉，

segments.orig:
ýat hê dathat razishta cista mazdadhâta
ashaoni pâdhave zâvare gaoshaêwe sraoma bâzuwe
aojô tanvô vîspayå drvatâtem tanvô
vîspayå vazdvare aomca sûkem ýim baraiti
karô masyô upâpô ýô ranghayå
dûraêpârayå jafrayå hazangrô-
vîrayå varesô-stavanghem âpô urvaêsem
mârayeiti.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide! (Repeat verse
4.)
segments.en:
That the most right Chista, made by Mazda and holy, would
give him the swiftness of the feet, the quick hearing of the ears,
the strength of the arms, the health of the whole body, the sturdiness
of the whole body, and the eye-sight of the Kara fish, that lives
beneath the waters, and can measure a rippling of the waters not
thicker than a hair, in the Rangha, whose ends lie afar and whose
depth is a thousand times the height of a man.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer unto her a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh:
那最正確的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，將
給他腳的迅速，耳朵的敏捷聽見，
手臂的力量，全身的健康，堅固
全身的，以及卡拉魚的視力，該魚居住，
在水底下，並能測量水波紋不
比頭髮還粗，在蘭哈，其兩端遠遠分開，且其
深度是人的身高的一千倍。
為她的光亮與榮耀，我將獻上祭品給她。
值得被聽見....

segments.en:
That the most right Chista, made by Mazda and holy, would
give him the swiftness of the feet, the quick hearing of the ears,
the strength of the arms, the health of the whole body, the sturdiness
of the whole body, and the eye-sight of the male horse, that,
in the dark of the night, through the rain, the snow, the hail,
or the sleet, from as far as nine districts, can perceive a horse's
hair, mingled with the earth, and knows whether it is from the
head or from the tail.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer unto her a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh:
那最正確的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，將
賜予他腳的迅速，耳的敏聽
手臂的力量，全身的健康，堅固
全身的，以及雄馬的視力，那
在夜晚的黑暗中，經過雨、雪、雹，
或是凍雨，從遠達九區，能感知馬的
頭髮，與大地混雜，並知道它是否來自
頭部或來自尾部。
為她的光亮與榮耀，我將向她獻上祭祀。
值得被聽見....

kahrkâsô zarenumainyush ýô naomyâcit

brâzem avavatcit ýatha sûkayå naêzem.

That the most right Chista, made by Mazda and holy, would
give him the swiftness of the feet, the quick hearing of the ears,
the strength of the arms, the health of the whole body, the sturdiness
of the whole body, and the eye-sight of the vulture with a golden
collar, that, from as far as nine districts, can perceive a piece
of flesh, not thicker than a fist, giving just as much light as
a needle gives, as the point of a needle gives.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer unto her a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh:
那最正確的奇斯塔，由馬茲達製造且聖潔，將
給予他腳的敏捷，耳朵的快速聽力，
手臂的力量，全身的健康，堅固
全身的，以及禿鷹的視力，帶有金色的
項圈，那，從遠達九個區域，能感知一塊
的肉體，不比拳頭厚，提供與...同等的光亮
一根針給出，正如針尖給出。
因她的光亮與榮耀，我將向她獻上祭祀。
值得被聽見....

segments.orig:
ýãm ýazata hvôvi ashaoni vîthushi
vohu bakhem isemna ashavanem zarathushtrem anumatêe daênayâi
anuxtêe daênayâi anvarshtêe daênayâi.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide! (Repeat verse
4.)
segments.en:
To whom the holy Hvovi did sacrifice with full knowledge,
wishing that the holy Zarathushtra would give her his good narcotic,
that she might think according to the law, speak according to
the law, and do according to the law.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer unto her a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh:
誰聖潔的 Hvovi 帶著完全的知識祭祀，
希望聖潔的 Zarathushtra 會給她他的好麻醉，
使她能依律法思考，依律法說話
，依律法行事。
為她的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上一個祭祀給她
值得被聽見....
(重複第 4 節).

segments.orig:

maremnem isemnô daênayâi amem isemnô tanuye.
ahe raya ... tåscâ ýazamaide! (Repeat verse
4.)
segments.en:
To whom the Athravans, sent afar, did sacrifice, wishing a
good memory to preach the law, and wishing strength for their
own body.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer unto her a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh:
誰阿特拉瓦恩斯，被派往遠方，祭祀，希望一個
良好記憶來宣講律法，並希望他們
自己的身體。
為她的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上一個祭祀給她
值得被聽見....
(重複第 4 節).

4.)
segments.en:
To whom the king of the country, the lord of the country does
sacrifice, wishing peace for his country, wishing strength for
his own body.
For her brightness and glory, I will offer unto her a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh:
誰國家的國王，國家的領主 做
祭祀，希望他國家和平，希望他
自己的身體。
為她的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上一個祭祀給她
值得被聽見....
(重複第 4 節).

(hôrmezd i hvadâe i awazûnî mardum

segments.en:
Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
I bless the sacrifice and prayer, and the strength and vigour
of the most right Chista, made by Mazda and holy, and of the good
Law of the worshippers of Mazda.
Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
[Give] unto that man brightness and glory, .... give him long,
long life, give him the bright, all-happy, blissful abode of the
holy Ones.
segments.zh:
亞胡·瓦伊羅：主的意志是聖潔之律....
我祝福祭祀與祈禱，以及力量與活力
至正的奇斯塔，由馬茲達所造且聖潔，以及善良的
馬茲達崇拜者之律。
阿舍姆·沃胡：聖潔是一切善事中最好的....
[Give] 賜予那人光明與榮耀，.... 賜予他長長的
長長的生命，賜予他光明、皆幸福、福樂的居所
聖者們。
